name: Vibrant Rainbow
tagline: Full-bleed pink, violet, blue and teal gradient with glossy glass orbs, frosted-glass cards and tight Inter Tight headlines with Instrument Serif italic accents (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: diagonal pink-to-teal rainbow gradient with white text, amber highlights and translucent glass panels

typography.style: tight heavy grotesque headlines with elegant serif italic emphasis words and clean sans body

best_for: Energetic launches and keynote openers that should feel premium and optimistic: fintech, SaaS and creator products. Glass cards make metrics and feature steps pop.
avoid_for: Serious legal, medical or academic material where a colorful gradient would undercut credibility.
